about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P440e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P440e is part of the L460 generation, introduced in 2022 as a plug-in hybrid variant of the flagship luxury SUV. It uses the AJ300 — a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-six petrol engine — paired with a 105kW electric motor, delivering 440PS combined output. The P440e sits alongside the P460e, P510e and P550e PHEV badges, all sharing the same AJ300 engine family with different power output tunes. The Range Rover P440e is a current variant and remains in production as of 2026.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300 engines for every Range Rover P440e on the road.
